value.rationale: The four-cube is a canonical highly structured, nonchordal, sixteen-vertex graph. Its two-independence complex has an exact mixed three-/four-sphere wedge, contrary to the single-degree cases of smaller cubes and unlike families in the initial classification. A verified integral attaching nullhomotopy resolves a natural finite topological invariant, beyond routine face counting; no general theorem is overstated.
